description: Add an outbound webhook endpoint: Last Price sends a signed POST to the https url for each event you list. The answer carries the signing secret (whsec_...); keep it to verify deliveries. Events cover held agent calls awaiting approval, disputes, proposed price changes, a low balance, outcomes and changelog entries; the documentation lists their names, and an unknown name is refused. Send ping_webhook afterwards to check the endpoint answers. Needs the owner or admin role, and a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

events.description: The events to send, at least one, e.g. ["approval.requested","dispute.opened"].

secret.description: Your own signing secret. Omit it and one is made for you.

url.description: Where to send events. Must start with https://.

name: create_webhook
